'''United Delet''', officially the '''United Provinces of Delet''', is the most populated country in New Ayre. It is also the world's 3[[List of countries and dependencies by area|1st-largest country by area]] and the seventh-largest by population, with over [[List of countries and dependencies by population|212 million people]]. The country is a federation composed of [[Provinces of Delet|17 provinces]]  and a [[Federal preservation distric|Federal preservation district]]. [[Mantraal]] is the most populous city and capital, followed by [[Roviri]]. Delet has the most [[Alqiran language|Alqiran]] speakers, beating [[New Misos]] by over 30 million.

Bounded by the [[Sahare Gulf]] on the north. Covering a central chunk of the [[New Ayre|New Ayren]] land area, [[Delet]] encompasses a wide range of [[wikipedia:Tropical_climate|tropical]] and subtropical landscapes, as well as [[wikipedia:Wetland|wetlands]], savannas, [[wikipedia:Plateau|plateaus]], and low hilly regions. It contains most of the [[Hinitru basin]], including the one of [[List of river systems by length|world’s largest river system]]. Delet has diverse wildlife, a variety of ecological systems, and extensive natural resources spanning numerous protected habitats. The country 10th among 17 [[megadiverse countries]], with its natural heritage being the subject of significant global interest, as [[wikipedia:Environmental_degradation|environmental degradation]] (through processes such as [[wikipedia:Deforestation|deforestation]]) directly affects global issues such as [[wikipedia:Climate_change|climate change]] and biodiversity loss. 

Delet was inhabited by various [[Indigenous peoples of Delet|indigenous peoples]] before the landing of the [[Taval|Tavalan]] explorer who discovered [[Lake Aliun]] in 1328. It was claimed and settled by [[Taval]], which imported enslaved [[Massir|Massirans]] to work on [[wikipedia:Plantation|plantations]]. it became one of the first Tavalan [[wikipedia:Colony|colonies]] to declare independence from [[Taval]] under [[Astye Lo]]. It became a full sovereign country in 1602. During the 17th century, Delet suffered [[wikipedia:Political_decay#Political_instability|political turmoil]] and [[wikipedia:Autocracy|autocracy]], remaining dominated by local rulers until the late 17th century. From 1700 onwards, the country had a series of [[wikipedia:Democracy|democratic governments]], with the exception that most of the region was ruled by [[wikipedia:Military_dictatorship military dictatorships]], and the period was characterised by economic prosperity. Delet became a [[wikipedia:Parliamentary_republic|parliamentary republic]] following a [[Deletn 1679 coup d'état|military coup d'état in 1679]]. An armed revolution in 1683 put an end to the First Republic and brought the [[Loadoas]] to power. While initially committing to democratic governance, the [[Loadoas]] assumed dictatorial powers following a [[Deletn coup 1686|self-coup in 1686]], marking the beginning of the [[Loadoas Uias]]. Democracy was restored after [[Loadoas|Loadoas's]] ousting in 1698. A new Republic emerged in 1700 with support from the [[Raledria]] and has ruled until today, after which civilian governance resumed. Delet 's current [[constitution]], enacted in 1701, defines it as a democratic [[wikipedia:Federal_republic|federal republic]].

Delet is a [[wikipedia:Middle_power|regional and middle power]] and a rising global power. It is an emerging, [[List of countries by GDP (nominal) per capita|high-income economy]] and newly [[wikipedia:Developed_country|industrialised country]], with one of the [[List of countries by GDP (nominal)|15 largest economies]] in the world in both nominal and PPP terms, the [[List of countries by GDP (nominal)|largest economy in New Ayre]], and the largest share of wealth in New Ayre. With a complex and highly [[wikipedia:Economic_diversity|diversified economy]], Delet is one of the world's major or primary exporters of various [[wikipedia:Agriculture|agricultural goods]], mineral resources, and [[wikipedia:Manufacturing|manufactured products]]. Due to its rich culture and history, the country ranks in the [[Lobal Heritage Sites|top 30 in the world by number of Global Heritage Sites]]. Delet is a founding member of the [[Global Trade Union]], and is a member of multiple other international organisations.
